description: Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 that speeds up minecarts only while a player is riding them. Hopper, chest and every other cart stay vanilla.

mods.name: Fast Player Minecarts
mods.description: Minecarts with a player inside travel several times faster. Every other minecart keeps vanilla physics, including hopper, chest, furnace, TNT, spawner and command block carts as well as empty and mob ridden ones, so farms and sorting systems are not affected.

releases.notes:
First release, for Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric.

Minecarts with a player riding them travel 3x faster by default, about 24 blocks per second. Every other minecart keeps vanilla physics, including hopper, chest, furnace, TNT, spawner and command block carts as well as empty and mob ridden ones, so farms and item transport keep their normal timing.

The speed comes from running the cart's movement several times per game tick rather than raising the speed limit, so rails, curves, slopes, detector rails, activator rails, friction and powered rail boosts all still behave the way they always did. Existing tracks and booster spacing keep working.

### Installing

Server side only. Drop `fastcarts-1.0.0.jar` into your server's `mods` folder along with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). Players can join with a plain vanilla client and still get the faster carts. Single player and LAN worlds work too.

### Configuring

Operators can use `/fastcarts multiplier` to see the current setting and `/fastcarts multiplier <1-8>` to change it. Changes apply right away, no restart needed, and the value is saved to `config/fastcarts/settings.json`. Setting it to `1` turns the boost off.

### Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Fabric API
- Java 25
